description: A real compressed-file format with no optional header fields: a 10-byte header, a raw DEFLATE stream, and an 8-byte trailer holding the CRC-32 of the uncompressed data and its length. Exercises a two-byte binary signature, single-byte method and flag constants, a varying modification time, an opaque high-entropy body whose length is given by no field, and a fixed trailer whose checksum covers bytes that are not in the file.

provenance.origin: Compressed text written by corpus/gzip/generate.py with zlib at level 9 and decompressed with Python's gzip module and gzip -t.
provenance.notes: Not derived from any third-party file. Safe to redistribute.
